name: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Curl.EXE
description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses using curl.exe
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\curl.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:curl.exe) AND process.command_line:/:\/\/[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}/ AND process.command_line:*http* AND (process.command_line:(*\ \-O* OR *\-\-remote\-name* OR *\-\-output*)) AND (process.command_line:(*.bat OR *.bat\" OR *.dat OR *.dat\" OR *.dll OR *.dll\" OR *.exe OR *.exe\" OR *.gif OR *.gif\" OR *.hta OR *.hta\" OR *.jpeg OR *.jpeg\" OR *.log OR *.log\" OR *.msi OR *.msi\" OR *.png OR *.png\" OR *.ps1 OR *.ps1\" OR *.psm1 OR *.psm1\" OR *.vbe OR *.vbe\" OR *.vbs OR *.vbs\" OR *.bat' OR *.dat' OR *.dll' OR *.exe' OR *.gif' OR *.hta' OR *.jpeg' OR *.log' OR *.msi' OR *.png' OR *.ps1' OR *.psm1' OR *.vbe' OR *.vbs'))
